prompt: Create a cinematic surreal 16:9 wide image about Brahms Piano Concerto No. 1: a young romantic-era male pianist with wavy brown hair in a black velvet tuxedo performs at the center of a dark glossy circular stage on an impossible black grand piano shaped like a Möbius loop, with the keyboard wrapping around the front curve and the piano body arching into a sculptural oval. Surround the pianist with exactly 24 life-size audience statues arranged in a circular amphitheater ring: 12 matte white neoclassical conservative figures on the left side, dressed in 19th-century formal coats, cravats, bonnets, and top hats, some cracked with glowing yellow fissures; and 12 futuristic progressive figures on the right side, polished chrome and iridescent rainbow like liquid metal, with abstract modern silhouettes and reflective surfaces. A thick circular waveform of explosive paint and light encircles the piano and cuts between both camps, transitioning from hot red and orange on the left through yellow and green to electric cyan and blue on the right, with splashes, sparks, and jagged audio-wave peaks. The composition should feel like conservatives and progressives frozen in judgment around a wild piano performance, viewed from a high three-quarter angle, ultra-detailed, dramatic studio lighting, deep navy-black background, glossy reflections on the floor, high contrast, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张 16:9 宽画幅的电影感超现实图像，主题为 勃拉姆斯第一钢琴协奏曲：一位年轻的 身着黑色天鹅绒燕尾服、留着棕色卷发的浪漫主义时期男性钢琴家 在深色光泽的圆形舞台中央演奏，钢琴是一架不可思议的黑色三角钢琴，形状如同莫比乌斯环，琴键环绕在前侧曲线，琴身呈雕塑般的椭圆形。在钢琴家周围布置 24 座真人大小的观众雕像，组成一个圆形露天剧场：左侧是 12 座哑光白色新古典主义保守派人物，身着 19 世纪正式大衣、领结、软帽和高礼帽，部分雕像带有发光的黄色裂纹；右侧是 12 座未来主义进步派人物，采用抛光铬合金和虹彩液体金属质感，具有抽象的现代轮廓和反射表面。一道厚重的圆形波形光影与喷溅颜料环绕着钢琴，将两个阵营隔开，色彩从左侧的炽热红橙色过渡到中间的黄色和绿色，再到右侧的电青色和蓝色，伴有飞溅、火花和参差不齐的音频波峰。构图应呈现出保守派与进步派在狂野的钢琴演奏周围陷入凝固的审视状态，采用高位四分之三视角，超高细节，戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，深海军蓝背景，地面带有光泽反射，高对比度，无文字，无水印。
